existing_group_assignments.rationale: "Lipid Peroxidation" is the same event as "Increase, Lipid peroxidation" in the existing group, with different wording.
"Decrease, Cell proliferation" is a general form of decreased proliferation/growth, differing in biological context from cortical neural progenitor cell proliferation.

new_groups.rationale: Decreased photosynthesis and decreased light harvest capacity are related plant photosynthetic function decreases at different specificity.
